{{Quote|I am a man of my word. Here is your granddaughter... as promised!|Pre Vizsla to Pieter before fatally stabbing Tryla|<ref name="AFIN" />}}
'''Tryla''' was a [[Ming Po/Legends|Ming Po]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Carlac/Legends|Carlac]] and the granddaughter of her people's [[Chief/Legends|chieftain]], [[Pieter/Legends|Pieter]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|We were kidnapped from a nearby town. We are a simple people. We trust easily, and we were betrayed.|Tryla|<ref name="AFIN" />}}
[[File:TrylaStabbed-AFIN.jpg|thumb|left|220px|Tryla is stabbed by Pre Vizsla]]
Tryla was kidnapped by [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]] and the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] when they chose the neutral world of Carlac for their base. She was taken to the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]]' camp and forced to serve the troops as a mere servant. While there, she befriended [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], unaware that she was a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. When her grandfather demanded the return of the women of his village, Vizsla agreed to the request, but immediately after returning Tryla to her grandfather, she was [[Shiak|stabbed]] in the back by the [[Darksaber/Legends|Darksaber]].<ref name="AFIN" />
